'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Brian Brodsky LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Brodsky]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-05-Careful_Planning-remaster.webp|label=Careful Planning (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' I Have No Idea
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
